messages:
jamie: Kicking off bring-up for us-west-2-edge1 — this one is an "edge" cluster that will primarily run Spot p4d/p5 and fallback to a tiny on-demand pool. I'm drafting the bootstrap + validation runbook. Want quick eyes on the validation checklist and known-issues section before I hand to ops.

olivia: Sounds good. Two asks: (1) make explicit the quota/limit requests and contact points for AWS account ops, (2) include a cheap load test to validate GPU eviction handling (spot interruptions).

devin: For the GPU hosts we should pin ENA + NVMe drivers and add a kernel-boot checklist. Last time we saw a flaky ENA version on c6g-ish AMIs that caused pod networking drops under high throughput.

maria: Adding note: MTU 9001 + CNI (calico) had performance wins but one site saw fragmentation issues with our NAT gateway. Add a verification step for large MTU across load-balancers and transit gateway.

leo: For cost notes — include the math comparing Spot pools vs Reserved Dedicated baseline. E.g., expected spot price ~0.2x on avg, but with 8% eviction we need to size fallback capacity.

jamie: Draft validation steps (high-level):
1) Quota + IAM checks (EC2, EBS, ENI, Elastic IP) and open AWS requests. Include contact list.
2) AMI check: ENA driver >= 2.6, nvidia-driver >= 535, cuda >= 12.1.
3) Kernel params: iommu=off? vs default — record what we used.
4) K8s node config: topology-manager=best-effort, kubelet-> --feature-gates=DevicePlugins.
5) NVMe volume mounting + fio smoke test for local SSDs.
6) GPU functional tests: nvidia-smi, CUDA sample run, model inference smoke (c10g synthetic).
7) Network stress: iperf3 across AZs and to LB, verify MTU.
8) Spot interruption test: simulate eviction and ensure pods drain & get replaced on fallback pool.
9) Cost burn test: 2h synthetic traffic at expected qps to verify token billing and pod autoscaler behavior.
10) Observability: confirm logs -> ES, traces -> jaeger, per-token latency traces show KV cache hits metric.

devin: Add concrete commands for checks (put in runbook):
```
# ENA version check
modinfo ena | grep version || ethtool -i eth0
# nvidia
nvidia-smi --query-gpu=name,driver_version --format=csv
# fio quick local SSD
fio --name=randwrite --filename=/dev/nvme0n1 --rw=randwrite --bs=4k --size=1G --numjobs=4 --time_based --runtime=30
```

maria: Known-issues to surface in the doc:
- MTU mismatch causing packet drops when transit gateway uses default 1500.
- NVMe interrupt storm on older AMIs causing kernel OOM under heavy disk stress.
- Spot eviction cascade when InstanceTypes are heterogeneous and AZ capacity varies.
- Kube-proxy iptables rules leaking after flannel restart (temporary workaround: restart kube-proxy).

leo: For handoff checklist to ops: short items to mark complete:
- Quota approvals received + ticket links
- AMI baked and verified (link)
- Terraform apply plan + dry-run approved
- Node pool autoscaling policy set + min fallback pool configured
- On-call rota updated with escalation matrix
- Cost alarm + budget threshold created

infra-bot: Reminder: Reservation availability in us-west-2-edge1 currently 0 for p5. Consider requesting dedicated capacity via sales if steady-state demand > 30 GPUs.

sre-oncall: If we hit networking flakiness, first action is to disable MTU 9001 at node level to confirm. Also watch for ENA driver logs under /var/log/messages for "resetting device" errors.

jamie: I'm going to add a small troubleshooting section with runbooks for the top three recurring failures: ENA resets, MTU fragmentation, spot eviction storms. Will attach the draft runbook here when done.

olivia: LGTM. After draft, create a short playbook for a 20m rollback to fallback cluster (on-demand) and a playbook for live capacity expansion (contact sheets + terraform knobs). :thumbsup:

devin: One more: include NUMA and MIG partition verification commands — we had a perf delta when MIG groups were misapplied.
```
nvidia-smi topo --matrix
nvidia-smi mig -l
```

jamie: Thanks all — I'll post the runbook link when uploaded. Planning to hand off to ops at 1810048000 if no blockers.
